summary: The sidebar picker route was confirmed dead: the bench-assignee menu item is an inert anchor (href "/bench/bench-repo/issues?assignee=3", class "item") whose click is prevented and produces no assignment even after re-opening, filtering and keyboard selection; a reload confirmed the sidebar still read "No Assignees". I then applied the assignment through Gitea's bulk assignee action on the issue list (checked issue #4, used the top "Assignee" dropdown, chose bench-assignee). Back on http://127.0.0.1:8095/bench/bench-repo/issues/4 the sidebar now reads "Assignees bench-assignee (Bench Assignee)" and the timeline shows "bench-assignee was assigned by admin"; labels remain bug and priority-high, unchanged.
